#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

vector<bool> prime;

struct Pair {
    int a, b;
    Pair(int a, int b) : a(a), b(b) {}
    bool operator<(const Pair& o) const { return a < o.a; }
};

long long power(long long base, long long exp, long long modVal) {
    long long result=1;
    base %= modVal;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % modVal;
        exp >>= 1;
        base = (base * base) % modVal;
    }
    return result;
}

void sortArray(vector<long long>& array) {
    std::sort(array.begin(), array.end());
}

struct FastScanner {
    std::istringstream iss;
    std::string line;
    FastScanner() {}
    std::string next() {
        while (!(iss >> std::ws), !(iss >> line)) {
            if (!std::getline(std::cin, line)) return "";
            iss.clear();
            iss.str(line);
        }
        return line;
    }
    int nextInt() { return std::stoi(next()); }
    long long nextLong() { return std::stoll(next()); }
    double nextDouble() { return std::stod(next()); }
    std::vector<int> readArray(int n) {
        std::vector<int> a(n);
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) a[i]=nextInt();
        return a;
    }
    std::vector<long long> readLongArray(int n) {
        std::vector<long long> a(n);
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) a[i]=nextLong();
        return a;
    }
};

void sieveOfEratosthenes(int n) {
    prime.assign(n+1, true);
    for (int p=2; p*p<=n; p++) {
        if (prime[p]) {
            for (int i=p*p; i<=n; i+=p) prime[i]=false;
        }
    }
}

int log2(int x) {
    return (int)(std::log(x)/std::log(2));
}

long long binomialCoeff(long long n, long long r) {
    if (r > n) return 0;
    long long m=1000000007LL;
    std::vector<long long> inv(r+1,1);
    if (r+1 >= 2) inv[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=r; i++) {
        inv[i]=m - (m/i)*inv[(int)(m%i)]%m;
    }
    long long ans=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=r; i++) {
        ans=(ans*inv[i])%m;
    }
    for (long long i=n; i>=n-r+1; i--) {
        ans=(ans*i)%m;
    }
    return ans;
}

long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
    while (b != 0) {
        long long t=b;
        b=a%b;
        a=t;
    }
    return a;
}

static long long facts[300000];
static long long mod=1000000007LL;

long long multiply(long long a, long long b) { return (a*b)%mod; }
long long addMod(long long a, long long b) { return (a+b)%mod; }

bool can(int v, const std::string& s) {
    std::string ss=std::to_string(v);
    char king='?';
    for (size_t i=0; i<ss.length(); i++) {
        char c=s[i];
        if (c!='_' && c!='X') {
            if (c!=ss[i]) return false;
        } else if (c=='_') {
            continue;
        } else if (c=='X') {
            if (king!='?' && ss[i]!=king) return false;
            if (king=='?') king=ss[i];
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    FastScanner fs;
    int t=1;
    while (t-- > 0) {
        std::string s=fs.next();
        int len=(int)s.length();
        int maxVal=(int)std::pow(10,len)-1;
        int minVal=(int)std::pow(10,len-1);
        if (minVal==1) minVal--;
        if (s[0]=='0' && s.length()>1) {
            std::cout << "0\n";
            continue;
        }
        long long ans=0;
        for (int i=minVal; i<=maxVal; i++) {
            if (i%25==0 && can(i, s)) ans++;
        }
        std::cout << ans << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
